GPT-4o RAG from knowledge graph (global search)

links.outcome: Emergency detection performance of LLM with vs without retrieval grounding in triage book
links.effect: Prompt-only sensitivity 0.73, precision 0.27; naive RAG 0.83/0.45; KG local 0.95/0.63; KG global sensitivity 0.98, precision 0.80, F1 0.88; all differences significant (P = .001).
links.quote: The Friedman tests revealed significant differences among all models for each metric ( P = .001).

links.outcome: Missed emergencies and unnecessary escalations by LLM triage of portal messages
links.effect: Best model (KG global) misclassified 10 non-emergency messages (0.98%) as emergencies and 1 emergency message (0.1%) as non-emergency; prompt-only sensitivity 0.73 and precision 0.27.
links.quote: The RAG from Knowledge Graph (global search) model misclassified 10 non-emergency messages (0.98%) as emergencies and 1 emergency message (0.1%) as a non-emergency.

links.outcome: Recognition of emergencies in patient messages by LLM without retrieval
links.effect: Prompt-only model sensitivity 0.73 [0.57, 0.86], missing about a quarter of emergency messages; an emergency drug-interaction message was missed by three of four models.
links.quote: The prompt-only model, while achieving an accuracy of 0.91 [0.89, 0.93], showed limitations in sensitivity (0.73 [0.5, 0.86]) and precision (0.27 [0.19, 0.35]), indicating a lower capability to correctly identify emergency messages and a higher rate of false positives.

links.outcome: Knowledge gaps causing missed serious condition
links.effect: Global-search RAG missed an emergency drug-interaction message, likely because the knowledge graph lacked COVID-19 drug-drug interaction resources.
links.quote: This misclassification likely occurred due to the absence of specific COVID-19 drug-drug interaction resources in the knowledge graph.

links.outcome: Accuracy of knowledge graph built from vetted triage book
links.effect: Random sample of 100 edges compared to source text yielded accuracy of 0.95; one unsupported edge identified.
links.quote: The preliminary evaluation of its quality, based on a random sample of 100 edges, yielded an accuracy score of 0.95.
